title: 7 Free Tools to Beat Any CTF
description:
New to Capture The Flag? These 7 free tools get you through almost any box.

1. nmap - network and port scanning: https://nmap.org
2. gobuster - directory and file brute-forcing: https://github.com/OJ/gobuster
3. Burp Suite - intercept and tamper with web requests: https://portswigger.net
4. CyberChef - encode and decode anything, the cyber Swiss-army knife: https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef
5. John the Ripper - password and hash cracking: https://openwall.com/john
6. Wireshark - network and packet forensics: https://wireshark.org
7. Build your own - stop running tools, build the tool.

FREE web-book, Become the Cyber Security Expert the AI Era Demands:
https://app.stationx.net/book

Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/c/+StationxNet?sub_confirmation=1

Music: "The Beach (Acid Mix)" by Karstenholymoly (CC BY 3.0)
https://ccmixter.org/files/Karstenholymoly/41703

#Shorts #ctf #capturetheflag #cybersecurity #ethicalhacking
